explanation: Map each ordered keyword to its index. Track its latest occurrence and the shortest sequentially covering segment ending there, extending from the previous keyword’s saved segment. Update the result whenever the final keyword completes a shorter segment.
timeComplexity: O(S+n+k) expected time for n paragraph words, k keywords and S hashed characters.
spaceComplexity: O(k) state entries plus stored keyword characters.
